title: AI Designer
backHelp: Go back to the AI Designer home to see all your designs or start a new one.

home.heading: Describe it. Watch it take shape.
home.intro: Tell the AI what you want in plain words. It designs the pages, sets up the data and forms, and you keep changing it until it's right.
home.aiNotReady: The AI isn't set up on this server yet, so designs can't be built.
home.formHelp: Describe the app or website you want in your own words. The AI may ask a couple of quick questions, then designs the pages for you.
home.promptLabel: What do you want to make?
home.promptHelp: Say who it's for and what visitors should be able to do, like book a time or send a message. Press Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on Mac) to start.
home.promptPlaceholder: e.g. A booking site for my dog walking business, where customers pick a time and I see every booking
home.promptTip: Say who it's for and what they do on it.
home.startHelp: Creates a new design and opens it. The AI may ask a few quick questions before it starts building.
home.ideaHelp: Fills the box above with a ready-made example description. Edit it to fit your idea, then press Design it.

dogWalking.title: Dog walking bookings
dogWalking.prompt: A booking site for my dog walking business. Customers pick a walk (30 or 60 minutes), a day and a time, and leave their dog's name. I see every booking on a private page.

bakery.title: Neighbourhood bakery
bakery.prompt: A warm website for a small neighbourhood bakery: today's bakes, opening hours, a pre-order form for cakes, and a map.

yoga.title: Yoga studio
yoga.prompt: A calm yoga studio site with the weekly class schedule, teacher profiles, and a form to book a first free class.

wedding.title: Wedding site
wedding.prompt: An elegant wedding website with our story, the day's schedule, travel tips, and an RSVP form with meal choice.

plumber.title: Plumber leads
plumber.prompt: A trustworthy local plumber site with services, service area, reviews, and a quote request form that saves every lead.

bookClub.title: Book club
bookClub.prompt: A friendly book club site: this month's book, past reads, meeting dates, and a form to suggest the next book.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.prompt: A bold portfolio for a freelance illustrator with selected work, about, and a contact form for commissions.

foodTruck.title: Food truck
foodTruck.prompt: A punchy food truck site with the menu, where we'll be this week, and a catering enquiry form.

home.yourDesignsHelp: Everything you've designed with the AI. Click a card to open it and keep changing it.
home.empty: Nothing yet. Describe your first one above.

card.openHelp: Open this design to see it full size and ask the AI for changes.
card.optionsHelp: Rename, copy or delete this design.
card.renameHelp: Give this design a new name so it is easy to find in your list.
card.copyHelp: Makes a separate copy of this design and opens it, so you can try ideas without changing the original.
card.deleteHelp: Deletes this design for good after you confirm. If its app hasn't moved to the page builder, the app is deleted too. This can't be undone.
card.confirmDeleteWithApp: Delete "{name}"? Its app is deleted too.

workspace.tabChatHelp: Your chat with the AI: ask for changes and see what it did.
workspace.tabPreviewHelp: See how your design looks right now.
workspace.conversationHelp: Your chat with the AI about this design. Ask for changes here; every change is saved as a new version.
workspace.openAppHelp: Go to the app this design belongs to, where you can see its pages, data and publishing options.
workspace.emptyChat: Describe what you want and the AI will design it. You can keep asking for changes, or click things in the preview to comment on them.
workspace.seeVersionHelp: Show what the design looked like right after this change. Nothing is changed until you choose Restore.
workspace.questionsHelp: A few details help the AI get it right first time. Answer what you can; every question is optional.
workspace.pickAnswerHelp: Pick this answer. You can change it or type your own below before building.
workspace.buildItHelp: Start designing using your description and the answers you gave.
workspace.skipQuestionsHelp: Start designing from your description alone. The AI will make sensible choices for anything you didn't say.
workspace.movedNotice: This design moved to the page builder, so the AI Designer can't change it any more.
workspace.openInBuilderHelp: Open this app in the page builder, where you now edit it by dragging and dropping.
workspace.copyToKeep: Make a copy to keep designing
workspace.copyToKeepHelp: Make a separate copy of this design that the AI can still change. The app in the page builder stays as it is.
workspace.removeNoteHelp: Remove this comment so the AI ignores it.
workspace.askHelp: Tell the AI what to change, in your own words. Press Enter to send; Shift+Enter starts a new line.
workspace.stopHelp: Stop the AI part-way through this change.
workspace.sendHelp: Send your request and any comments to the AI. It updates the design and saves a new version.
workspace.confirmRestore: Go back to this version? Your current version stays in the history.
workspace.confirmRestoreHome: This older version only kept the home page. Restore the home page from it?
workspace.confirmMove: Move this app to the page builder? You'll edit it there from now on, and the AI Designer can't change it any more. You can still make a copy of this design to keep designing with AI.
workspace.pageHelp: Choose which page of your design to show in the preview.
workspace.screenSizeHelp: Preview your design at computer, tablet or phone size to check it looks good everywhere.
workspace.desktopHelp: Show the preview at full computer-screen width.
workspace.tabletHelp: Show the preview at tablet width.
workspace.phoneHelp: Show the preview at phone width.
workspace.commentHelp: Turn on, then click any part of the preview to leave a note about it. Your notes go to the AI with your next message.
workspace.versionsHelp: See every saved version of this design. You can look at an older one and bring it back.
workspace.downloadHelp: Download every page of this design as a single zip file you can open on your computer or host elsewhere.
workspace.openNewTab: Open the preview in a new tab
workspace.openNewTabHelp: Open this page on its own in a new browser tab to try it at full size.
workspace.moveToBuilderHelp: Hand this app over to the drag-and-drop page builder. After that the AI Designer can't change it, but you can still copy the design.
workspace.earlierVersion: You're looking at an earlier version.
workspace.restoreItHelp: Make this older version the current one. Your current version stays in the history, so you can switch back.
workspace.backToCurrentHelp: Stop looking at the old version and show the latest one again.
workspace.commentInputHelp: Describe what should change about the part you clicked, like make it bigger or change the wording.
workspace.addHelp: Save this note. It waits above the chat box until you press Send, so you can add several first.
workspace.cancelNoteHelp: Close this without adding a note.
workspace.commentTip: Add as many as you like, then press Send to make all the changes at once.
workspace.versionsPanelHelp: Every change to this design is saved here, newest first. View an older version or restore it.
workspace.noVersions: Each change you make is saved here.
workspace.viewHelp: Show this version in the preview. Nothing changes until you restore it.
workspace.restoreHelp: Make this version the current one. The version you have now stays in the history.

server.tryAgain: Something went wrong. Please try again.
server.alreadyBuilding: This design is already being built. Wait for it to finish, or stop it.
server.movedToBuilder: This design moved to the page builder, so the AI Designer can't change it any more. To keep designing with AI, make a copy of it.
server.stillBuilding: This design is still being built. Wait until it's done, then switch.
server.nothingToMove: There's nothing to move yet. Ask the AI Designer to make something first.
server.restoredHome: Restored the home page from an earlier version.
server.previewEmpty: Nothing here yet. Describe your app to build it.
server.previewMissing: This page doesn't exist in this version.

build.failed: The build didn't work this time. Nothing was changed; please try again.
build.appNotUpdated: Your design is saved, but its app couldn't be updated: {reason}.
build.fileFailed: The AI couldn't write {file}. Nothing was changed; please try again.
